comparison.read: same window (10-15..11-13), different sample seed (20261116 vs 20261110), so this is a same-population re-draw, not a new time point: floor 63.8% vs 60.1%, burst 20.6% vs 28.3%, median 32 vs 34. The band ordering replicates; the seed-to-seed spread on burst (28.3 -> 20.6) is sampling noise at n=200 and is the honest error bar for any single point.
